# KineSync data v2 (generated by tools/merge_release.py)

## Size
- videos in release: 553 (35.7 hours), artists: 239
- downloaded OK but not processed yet (listed in pending_not_processed.csv): 16
- duplicate YouTube videos removed: 29
- failed validation and excluded: 0

## Videos per genre and split (split is by ARTIST; seed 42; val 10%, test 10%)
```
split       train  val  test
genre                       
electronic     82   12    13
hiphop         87   13    13
pop            86   12    14
rnb_latin      86   12    12
rock           88   12    11
ALL           429   61    63
```

Artists per split: {'val': 25, 'train': 188, 'test': 26}
Eval rule: all videos of a val/test artist stay together in that split

## Audio, video and lyrics
- grids: audio features 10 fps, video features 2 fps, CLAP 1 Hz, exact cut times in seconds (`cut_times`)
- cuts per minute: median 33.1; shots per video: median 123
- lyric lines kept: 21345; kept-lyric coverage of a song: median 59%, 10th percentile 20%
- Whisper language reported: {'en': 478, 'es': 40, 'ru': 11, 'ko': 7, 'nn': 4, 'ja': 4}; videos with a language other than en/es: 35 (often a misdetection)
- lyrics MASKED (every line kept=false) because the language was not en/es: 35 videos, listed in masked_lyrics.csv

## Known limitations
- `year` and `video_type` in splits.csv are PLACEHOLDERS
- sections are plain segment numbers (no verse/chorus labels); downbeat_phase is all zeros
- scale / camera-moving / tags are automatic labels
- calibration (calib_v1.json) was fitted on the 40-video pilot, not on the train split only
- tag_scores are z-scores (>= 1.0), not raw CLIP similarities
- lyrics come from Whisper `base` on the full mix (no vocal separation)
